story.titleZh: 阿斯顿马丁车手：满意表现但直道损失圈速
story.summaryZh: 阿斯顿马丁F1车手表示对周五表现和赛车平衡满意，但在直道上损失大量圈速，可能让正赛变得困难。

media.altZh: 阿斯顿马丁车手：满意表现但直道损失圈速 · 第 1 张

story.originalTitle: "I was happy with my performance and with the overall balance of the car today compared to yesterday. We are losing a lot of lap time on the straights...
story.summaryEn:
"I was happy with my performance and with the overall balance of the car today compared to yesterday. We are losing a lot of lap time on the straights, and so I think it will make the race difficult for us."
Debrief our Friday at the #AzerbaijanGP: https://www.astonmartinf1.com/en-GB/races/2026-azerbaijan-gp
detailZh:
“我对自己的表现以及今天赛车相比昨天的整体平衡感到满意。我们在直道上损失了很多圈速，所以我认为这会让我们的正赛变得困难。”
回顾我们在#阿塞拜疆大奖赛的周五：https://www.astonmartinf1.com/en-GB/races/2026-azerbaijan-gp
detailEn:
"I was happy with my performance and with the overall balance of the car today compared to yesterday. We are losing a lot of lap time on the straights, and so I think it will make the race difficult for us."
Debrief our Friday at the #AzerbaijanGP: https://www.astonmartinf1.com/en-GB/races/2026-azerbaijan-gp
